# Nirmal Khedkar

Expert Software Engineer specializing in full-stack development, distributed systems, and mobile applications.

## Summary
From my experience, I bring a wealth of knowledge and experience to the table in a variety of areas, including expertise in all major JavaScript frameworks, proficiency in Spring Boot, and both native and hybrid mobile development. I also have experience in cloud deployment and working with both SQL and NoSQL databases. In addition, I am eager to continue developing my understanding of software deployment and cloud architecture, and am always looking for new opportunities to expand my skillset in these areas.


I also completed a Masters of Science in Computer Science at **a major US University**.

## Skills
C/C++, JAVA, Python, Javascript, GraphQL, MySQL, MongoDB, SpringBoot, Angular, Jekyll, Ruby on Rails, Android, Dialogflow, React, React Native, Numpy, Pandas, Scikit-Learn, Ionic, Gatsby, Postgresql, Solidity, Lodash, Project Reactor

## Experience

### Software Engineer Intern (During MS) | a healthcare data systems company | May 2025 - Aug 2025
- Tuned and integrated a recommendation model into a C#/.NET ambulance dispatch engine, cutting assignment time approximately 30% while refactoring scheduling logic and data-access components.

### Software Engineer | a global financial services company | Jun 2022 - Jul 2024
- Rearchitected multiple Developer Platform authentication and transaction-processing services from blocking request flows to non-blocking Reactor pipelines, redesigning downstream API integrations and improving per-instance throughput by 30% in equivalent pre-production load tests.
- Built Jenkins CI/CD security gates across 8 services using SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, and SonarQube to block failing deployments; contributed to an estimated 35% reduction in reported vulnerabilities.
- Owned Java 8-to-17 migration across 4 production Spring Boot services, benchmarking JVM configurations, presenting data-backed tuning recommendations, and deploying without performance regressions.
- Triaged live production incidents across payment APIs, using Splunk, Grafana, and Jenkins history to diagnose deployment, configuration, and customer-reported issues and coordinate cross-service fixes.

### Founding Software Engineer (Part Time / Undergrad) | a technology startup | Oct 2019 - May 2021
- Owned end-to-end engineering for an electronics repair marketplace, selecting the technology stack and building web/mobile applications and backend services from scratch.
- Integrated Razorpay payments and launched the marketplace to production, supporting 25–30 paid orders/week.
- Built reusable shared libraries and CI/CD pipelines to streamline cross-platform development, automate build and release workflows, and keep web/mobile delivery consistent as the engineering team expanded from 2 to 5 engineers.

### Software Engineering Intern | a global financial services company | May 2021 - Jul 2021
- Analyzed Visa Developer Platform API, product, route, and client traffic using SQL and GraphQL to identify adoption, throttling, and load patterns for product stakeholders.
- Built a unified backend and React analytics dashboard with load-prediction logic; evaluated API gateway endpoint performance and observed a 15% latency improvement in production-environment testing.

### Preemptive Kubernetes Autoscaler
Existing Kubernetes autoscalers are great but they are reactive in nature: it will only scale if your deployment has too much or too little traffic. Since human usage has patterns, deployment traffic will always have patterns, which is where our application comes in. We built a horizontal and vertical autoscaler that uses past historical data and accordingly adjust resources on the cluster.
